products.covid_cancellation_or_disruption_limit: On-trip Amendment/Cancellation Costs up to $5,000 per policy; Additional Expenses up to $2,500; No pre-departure cancellation cover.

cruise_benefits.conditions: No cover where confinement due to COVID-19

optional_add_ons.name: Cruise Cover (multi-night ocean/sea)
optional_add_ons.notes: Required to cover multi-night cruise-related claims

optional_add_ons.name: Cancellation Plus Cover
optional_add_ons.limit_changes: Pays 50% (Comprehensive) or 75% (Comprehensive+) of covered non-refundable costs up to $10,000 per policy

optional_add_ons.name: Adventure Activities Pack
optional_add_ons.notes: Expands covered activities; bonus packs for Golf, Triathlon, Scuba Diving, Mountain Biking

optional_add_ons.name: Motorcycle/Moped Riding
optional_add_ons.availability: Optional (≤250cc) and Motorcycle/Moped Riding+ (unlimited cc with conditions)

optional_add_ons.name: Increase Luggage Item Limit
optional_add_ons.availability: Optional per item up to aggregate increases of $15,000

products.limit_basis_notes: Limits apply per person unless stated. Section 4 Amendment/Cancellation applies per policy. Item limits apply per item/pair/set. COVID-19 cancellation sub-limits apply per policy. Cabin confinement $100 per day up to $1,500.
products.pre_existing_medical_conditions_summary: Claims related to Existing Medical Conditions are excluded unless the condition is automatically included (see list) or separately assessed and approved with extra premium. Some conditions cannot be covered. Undiagnosed/under investigation conditions are not covered.
products.pregnancy_cover_summary: Limited cover for serious, unexpected complications up to 23 weeks 6 days gestation. Childbirth and newborn care excluded. Multiple or assisted conception pregnancies and any pregnancy with prior complications require assessment and approval.
products.non_traveller_health_rules: Cover for cancellation/amendment due to a non-travelling Relative/business partner only if, at Relevant Time, they met conditions (no recent hospitalisation in last 12 months, not in aged care, living independently, not awaiting tests/treatment, no drug/alcohol addiction, no terminal illness). Otherwise max $1,000 total across the policy.

optional_activity_cover.details: List of specified activities including canyoning (organised tours), rock scrambling, trekking 3,000–4,000m (2+ days), etc.
Expanded list incl. rafting grades 4–5, ice climbing (≤2,000m), skydiving (not BASE), trekking 4,000–6,000m, Everest Base Camp, Kokoda Track.
On-piste and cross-country; Snow Sports+ adds off-piste and heli-ski/board (guided).
≤250cc or hired unlimited cc with strict licensing/experience conditions; no liability cover.

excluded_activities.scope: Excluded unless optional Motorcycle/Moped cover purchased; no Personal Liability cover in any case.
Excluded unless optional Snow Sports cover purchased.
Excluded.
Hunting, rodeo, BASE jumping, mountaineering with ropes/oxygen, trekking >6,000m, professional sports, etc.
All claims related to multi-night cruises excluded unless Cruise Cover added.

products.rental_vehicle_excess_conditions: Cover applies only if you hire a Rental Vehicle, are a named driver, and there is comprehensive insurance in place. No cover for admin/loss of use penalties. No cover if driven on unsealed surfaces (except specific Comp+ inclusions) or in breach of rental agreement.
products.luggage_conditions: Valuables not covered when checked in unless required by security. Unattended items in vehicles: limit $500 per item/$2,000 total during daylight in locked, concealed storage with forced entry; no cover overnight. Unattended in public places excluded. Proof of ownership required. Police/transport/accommodation reports required within 7 days.

general_exclusions.name: Known events/circumstances at Relevant Time
general_exclusions.description: Claims related to circumstances known or reasonably foreseeable at Relevant Time are excluded.

general_exclusions.name: Pregnancy exclusions
general_exclusions.description: No cover after 24th week; childbirth/newborn excluded; certain pregnancies require prior approval.

general_exclusions.name: Do not travel advisories and sanctions
general_exclusions.description: No cover if travelling against Do Not Travel when related to claim cause; sanctions restrictions apply.

general_exclusions.name: COVID-19 general
general_exclusions.description: No cover for COVID-19 except as extended in Section 23; government border/quarantine orders excluded.

products.travel_warning_and_sanctions_rules: No cover if travelling contrary to Smartraveller Do Not Travel advice related to the reason for the claim. Sanctions clause prohibits cover/benefits that would expose the insurer to sanctions (UN, AU, NZ, EU, UK, CH, US).
products.claims_process_summary: Submit online at claims.covermore.com.au with supporting documents; originals may be requested. Notify Us as soon as possible and within 60 days of return date. Emergency assistance must be contacted for hospitalisation/expenses >$2,000.
products.emergency_assistance_details: 24/7 assistance. Call +61 2 8907 5619 from overseas; toll-free numbers available for USA/Canada/UK/NZ. Contact as soon as possible if hospitalised, expenses likely to exceed $2,000, or for early return.
products.premium_factors: Destination/area of travel; departure date and trip duration; age; plan/tier; chosen excess; Cruise Cover; selected cancellation cover amount; approved Existing Medical Conditions/pregnancy cover; optional cover packs.
